name: komdosh-dev-spring-events
description: Add Kafka / SQS / RabbitMQ consumer authoring on top of komdosh-dev-spring-core. Ships the event-consumer-author agent and rules/event-consumers.md — manual offset/ack policy, mandatory idempotency via processed_events table, transient-vs-poison error handling, schema-registry DTOs, the one permitted runBlocking at the listener-thread boundary, Testcontainers tests, 8 forbidden patterns. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core for the foundational rules and core agents (migration-writer, test-writer).
